'''FC Chiasso''' is a [[Football in Switzerland|Swiss football]] club based in the [[Italian language|Italian-speaking]] municipality of [[Chiasso]]. It was founded in 1905. Chiasso also played in the Italian [[Serie A|first league]] between 1914 and 1923. They currently play in [[2. Liga (Switzerland)|2. Liga]], the sixth tier of Swiss football."}}
